title: Confetti Pop
blurb: The sharp bang of a party popper and the papery whoosh of confetti going up. It is a celebration compressed into under two seconds, which is precisely why it turns up on every stream alert, every we-hit-ten-thousand post and every mildly ironic congratulation in a group chat. The comedy is in the mismatch: fire it after something genuinely trivial and the gap between the fanfare and the achievement does all the work for you. Video editors keep it close for hard cuts to a reveal, where the pop functions as punctuation.
